decision_unit: bounded draft representation feasibility followed by native composition only if admitted
goal: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode with configured drafts 2/3 and exact target verification

downward_budget.limitation: Draft savings cannot alone close the remaining 4.78-second 40K gap; any retained dependency must compose with further verifier work. No projected API gain.

causal_origin: The rejected all-matrix per-channel INT8 audit found 5113/5120 FC row maxima on the hidden-half diagonal. Preserve that complete matrix in original BF16; change the seven other matrices to one fixed group128 representation. This is a role-aware owner/consumer change, not another all-matrix per-channel variant.

representation.other_seven_matrices: Per output row and contiguous K128 group: BF16 scale = RNE(max(abs(W))/127), symmetric RNE integer codes clipped to [-127,127], U8B128 storage. A zero group uses scale 1 and code 0.
representation.consumer_weight: RNE_BF16(FP32(q) * FP32(BF16 scale)), before BF16 Tensor Core multiplication

reference: Vendored vLLM Marlin dequant.h kU8B128 BF16 specialization and marlin_template.h scale() apply BF16 __hmul2 to grouped B fragments before MMA. Pinned upstream ccd49f6821ee110cc5a2b1aba620a8a1d66c7cbb; no new imported source or runtime dependency.

host_screen.inputs: Authenticated retained real P65 target-hidden, tokens and original independent FP64 full-layer outputs from the preceding feasibility audit; no new GPU capture.
host_screen.arithmetic: Independent FP64 projections on reconstructed BF16 operands; original BF16 publication, normalization, causal Attention and residual boundaries.
host_screen.gate: Unchanged maximum-row relative L2 <=0.02 for complete hidden/K/V against original full-layer FP64 reference, finite values and matching capture/checkpoint hashes. This isolates representation error and does not qualify a GPU reduction.
host_screen.budget: One fixed representation and one full 64-row host evaluation; no group-size, scale or outlier-threshold scan. Failure closes before runtime implementation.

conditional_composition.owner: Retain authenticated original weights; add one private packed owner and fixed scratch before readiness, no allocation/repacking during requests, unchanged 8-GiB actual startup reserve.
conditional_composition.consumer: FC retains CUTLASS; remaining projections consume packed INT8 directly through a fixed Marlin BF16 path. Full steps, cache-only append and initialization share one fixed physical M32 geometry, padded rows never reaching state.
conditional_composition.gates: Independent original-weight GPU draft oracle at unchanged 0.02 bound, exact within-route complete cache replay/guards, exact target prefix state/full logits and transaction/recovery admission.
conditional_composition.api_return: Immediately after admission, one P65/8K/40K d2 process versus retained v31 and non-MTP; report Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total and natural acceptance/work. Useful direction unlocks d3. Greater-than-3% Decode regression stops; neutral/negative removes the new route. At most one correctness repair, no local timing scan.
conditional_composition.expiry: A useful dependency must return in the next complete verifier architecture or be archived; no production promotion from a direction screen.

production: Unchanged non-MTP installed service; no target numerical waiver or accuracy-baseline substitution
